excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]外层气体的怪异活动打开了一些极深的开口，短暂地暴露出行星的固体核心。这一独特现象值得进一步研究。
excerpt.en: Strange movements in [from.GetName]'s gassy outer layers are causing exceptionally deep vents to open up, exposing the planet's solid core in brief intervals. This remarkable phenomenon warrants further study.

sections.en: Strange movements in [from.GetName]'s gassy outer layers are causing exceptionally deep vents to open up, exposing the planet's solid core in brief intervals. This remarkable phenomenon warrants further study.

texts.zh:
通过[from.GetName]上的暂时开口送入探测器，[Leader.GetName]发现行星的内核是一种单细胞有机物种的家园，它们与此前见过的一切生物都不相似。

这些强韧的细胞似乎完美地适应了在极端压力下的生活，它们季节性的繁殖活动会排出体积可观的氢气。[Leader.GetName]认为这就是行星之所以能维持氢气层的原因。

消灭这些生物能使外层的消散，获得一颗可殖民的石质行星。
texts.en:
By sending a probe deep into one of the temporary vents on [from.GetName], [Leader.GetName] discovered that the planet's core is home to a species of unicellular organisms unlike anything we have seen before.

These robust cells seem perfectly adapted for survival under extreme pressures, with their seasonal reproduction releasing sizable quantities of hydrogen. [Leader.GetName] has concluded that this is how the planet's gassy hydrogen layers are being maintained.

Exterminating these organisms would cause the dissipation of these outer layers, leaving behind a colonizable rocky planet.

label.zh: 这是个独特的观测机会。

texts.zh: [from.GetName]的气态外层由一种生活在其核心上的单细胞生物独特的生化过程所维持。将这些生物消灭可以让气体消散，使其下的岩质行星得以宜居。
texts.en: [from.GetName]'s gassy outer layers are maintained by the unique biochemistry of unicellular organisms which inhabit its core. Exterminating them would dissipate these gases, leaving us with a colonizable rocky planet.

texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]通过[from.From.GetName]上的一个开口送入了一台武器化的探测器。一抵达核心，其上的有毒载荷就会释放，侵染并灭绝当地的单细胞生物。

我们发现[from.From.GetName]的气态外层逐渐消散在虚空中，余下的是一颗小巧的岩质行星。
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] sent a weaponized probe into one of the openings on [from.From.GetName]'s surface. Once at the core, a toxic payload was released, infecting and exterminating its native single-celled organisms.

We observed as [from.From.GetName]'s gassy outer layers gradually dissipated into the void, leaving behind a small and rocky planet.
